title: Gears of War: E-Day Walkthrough - Episode 1: Emergence in Kalona
_note: Sifa's commentary over Xbox's official E-Day gameplay demo. 'at' is the time in the demo (seconds) when each line starts.

lines.text: Okay, here we go. That's a civil emergency broadcast for the Kalona District: follow safety protocols, proceed to the nearest shelter. So, yeah... it's starting.
And this is Kalona, on the night everything changes. Look at the detail in these streets: the wet roads, the neon signs, the abandoned cars. It already feels so tense.
Whoa, see that red glow in the road? That's an Emergence Hole. The Locust are literally coming up out of the ground.
Classic Gears: stay in cover, pick your shots, and never stand out in the open. And notice how fast Marcus moves between cover now, with the new movement.
Backup! A COG squad joins the fight near the Kalona Police Department. Never fight alone, right?
This red smoke is so atmospheric, and honestly terrifying. Visibility drops, so listen for the Locust before you can see them.
Oh! That execution. The new gore system is no joke.
Now we're inside a shopping center, and that is a big one. Heavy armor, heavy weapon. Time to find cover, fast.
Quick weapon swap here. Picking the right gun for close quarters in these aisles really matters.
Up close and personal! Melee kills in Gears always hit so hard.
Smashing through the freezer glass, using every bit of cover in the dairy aisle. I love how destructible this place is.
And here's the cutscene. Marcus is in serious trouble, with a Locust right on top of him. This is exactly the brutal, emotional Gears I was hoping for.
What a start! That's our first taste of E-Day. Subscribe, and I'll see you in the next episode.
